name: Piraeus Port Authority (PPA)
value: 51% bought for €280.5m (2016), raised to 67% for a further €88m (2021); container terminals II-III operated by COSCO since 2009; concession runs to 2052
china_gets: Control of the Mediterranean's largest container gateway into central and eastern Europe
host_position: Greece sold the stake under its bailout privatisation programme; COSCO had completed only about a third of the required investments by 2021
confidence_reason: Terms published by the Athens exchange (Euronext Athens), Reuters and trade press

name: Budapest-Belgrade railway
value: Hungary: $1.875bn China Exim loan (2020; 20 years, 2.5%) covering 85% of a 166km section; Serbia: several China Exim loans, with sections opened in 2022 and 2025
lender_builder: China Exim; China Railway Group / CRCC companies, partly with Hungarian partner RM International
china_gets: Construction contracts and a rail link from Piraeus into central Europe
host_position: Hungary classified the project's documents for 10 years; critics allege inflated costs; Serbia calls it a flagship project
confidence_reason: Loan terms from AidData and Reuters; Hungary's decision to classify the documents reported by Reuters

name: Bar-Boljare motorway, priority section
value: $944m China Exim loan (2014; 20 years, 2% fixed) for 85% of a €809.6m contract for 41km; about $557m still owed in July 2026
lender_builder: China Exim; China Road and Bridge Corp (CRBC)
china_gets: Construction contract, a sovereign-guaranteed loan, and tax exemptions for Chinese contractors
host_position: Montenegro asked the EU for help refinancing in 2021 and hedged the currency risk; the debt is still large relative to its economy
confidence_reason: Loan agreement published by Montenegro's government and in AidData

name: HBIS Smederevo steelworks
china_gets: Ownership of Serbia's only integrated steelworks
host_position: Serbia sold a loss-making state plant; residents complain about pollution

name: Zijin Bor copper (RTB Bor) and Cukaru Peki
value: 63% of RTB Bor for $350m (2018), with $1.26bn of investment pledged over 6 years, plus $200m to settle debts
china_gets: Control of Serbia's copper mines and smelter
host_position: Serbia sold the indebted state company on IMF advice; environmental fines and protests have followed
confidence_reason: Terms in Zijin's Hong Kong exchange filings and Reuters

name: Kostolac B3 coal unit and Drmno mine expansion
value: $608m China Exim loan for 85% of a $715.6m contract; 350 MW unit handed over in December 2024 after delays
host_position: Serbia says it strengthens energy security; Bankwatch criticises it as new coal
confidence_reason: Loan in AidData; handover announced by Serbia's government

name: Container Terminal Tollerort (Hamburg)
value: 24.99% for €46.4m (2023), cut from 35% by the German government
china_gets: A minority stake and preferred-hub status in Hamburg
host_position: Germany capped the stake below 25% and declared the terminal critical infrastructure
confidence_reason: From COSCO's filing and HHLA's release

name: CSP Zeebrugge Terminal
value: Bought out to 100% (76% from APM Terminals) in 2017
china_gets: Full ownership of a North Sea container terminal
host_position: A commercial sale, approved by Belgium
confidence_reason: From the COSCO and APM Terminals releases

name: Euromax Terminal Rotterdam
china_gets: A minority stake in a terminal at Europe's largest port
confidence_reason: Stake confirmed by COSCO's release only

name: Noatum Port Holdings (Valencia and Bilbao terminals)
china_gets: Control of Spain's major container terminal in Valencia, plus rail terminals

name: Peljesac bridge
value: Built under a HRK2.08bn (about €280m) contract; the EU paid €357m (85% of eligible costs); opened July 2022
lender_builder: China Road and Bridge Corp (CRBC) consortium; EU Cohesion Policy funds
china_gets: A showcase EU contract won by a Chinese state firm; China provided no money
host_position: Croatia and the EU present it as an EU project; the bid sparked EU subsidy concerns
confidence_reason: From the European Commission's regional-policy pages and Croatia's road agency

name: Stanari lignite power plant
value: €350m China Development Bank loan; 300 MW; operating since 2016
host_position: Republika Srpska backs it; Energy Community has flagged state-aid problems

name: Tuzla Unit 7 coal plant
value: €614m China Exim loan never drawn; the EPC contract was terminated in 2024; €126.5m of advances recovered
lender_builder: China Exim; China Gezhouba / GEDI consortium
host_position: Bosnia's power utility EPBiH ended the contract; disputes over refunds continue
confidence_reason: Termination and refund amounts come from regional trade press and a parliamentary reply

name: Kichevo-Ohrid and Miladinovci-Stip motorways
value: China Exim loans (about $278m for Miladinovci-Stip, which opened in 2019); Kichevo-Ohrid unfinished, with Exim financing ended and €175m of domestic bank funding
host_position: Repeated delays and cost overruns; Kichevo-Ohrid has a target of 2027
confidence_reason: Miladinovci-Stip loan in AidData; Kichevo-Ohrid status from Macedonian media

name: China Three Gorges in EDP and State Grid in REN
value: About 21% of EDP (2012); 25% of grid operator REN for €387m (2012)
china_gets: Board seats in Portugal's main power company and national grid
host_position: Portugal sold the stakes during its bailout privatisations
confidence_reason: From EDP's market notice and Reuters

name: Italy leaves the Belt and Road memorandum
value: Signed the BRI memorandum of understanding in 2019 (the only G7 member to do so); declined to renew it in December 2023
china_gets: Lost a G7 signatory; trade continues
host_position: Italy said the MoU brought few benefits
confidence_reason: Withdrawal reported by Reuters and CSIS; this is a policy action, not a project

name: China-Belarus Great Stone industrial park
value: About 112 sq km; around 157-160 resident companies; about $1.6bn in announced investment
lender_builder: China Merchants Group and Chinese state firms, with Belarus
china_gets: A tax-privileged manufacturing and logistics base on the China-Europe rail route
host_position: Belarus calls it a flagship of the partnership
confidence_reason: Figures are announced investment, reported by Belarusian state media

name: CATL Debrecen battery plant and BYD Szeged car plant
value: CATL: €7.3bn plant with about HUF129bn of direct Hungarian aid; BYD: more than HUF70bn of infrastructure support and other undisclosed aid
lender_builder: CATL, BYD (private but state-favoured); the Hungarian state is the subsidiser
china_gets: Manufacturing inside the EU, close to European carmakers
host_position: Hungary's government courts the plants; local protests over water and pollution
confidence_reason: These are private Chinese firms rather than state-led BRI projects; aid figures come from leaked contracts and Hungarian media
